expected_output: A reproducible Redis lab for Membership Lookup, with the requested behavior, one normal-case check, one edge-case check, and cleanup instructions in the README or notes.
acceptance_criteria: The solution implements the stated goal: Compare two sets of synthetic members.
The learner uses a disposable key namespace and does not include real personal data, passwords, or production credentials.
At least one normal and one boundary/error case are checked.
The result records the relevant command/version assumptions and a cleanup/reset step.
hints: Write down the data model and expected result before coding.
Use a unique demo: key prefix, and state what happens for a missing key or repeated request.
Static token checks are only smoke checks; run commands in a local compatible Redis environment and review the result manually.
grading_method: Static required-token smoke check only. This is not Redis command execution and does not prove correctness, atomicity, version compatibility, or recovery behavior; perform the local lab and human review described in the criteria.
retry_policy: Allow retries. Platform backend owns completion and reward idempotency; this file defines no XP override.
